[NCBK.7.1] **The engine owns the cache** ([LSTO.4.7]); the integrator does not
provide it. `cached()` reads the engine's own in-engine map — there is **no
cache-read callback.** The only cache callbacks are **optional write-through
persistence hooks**: `cache_set` / `cache_delete` that carry a write onward to an
external store so the cache survives a restart. NULL ⇒ a volatile in-engine cache
(the write still mutates the engine's cache; nothing is persisted).

The callback types are `ds_cache_set_cb_t` and `ds_cache_delete_cb_t`, declared in `runtime/include/libds.h`. Unlike every other area both are registered in one call, `ds_engine_cache_callbacks`, rather than by a setter each. What each hook receives and when it fires is [NSTG.2.4].
